headline: North-West lost 3 enterprise accounts after a warehouse breakdown caused missed deliveries.
body: All of July's account decline is concentrated in North-West, where a conveyor failure at WH-07 cut throughput and caused SLA misses [E1]. Two enterprise customers explicitly cited missed delivery windows as their reason for churning to a competitor [E3]. This looks like an operational failure driving customer loss, not a broader demand issue.

actions.driver: Fulfilment SLA misses from WH-07 outage
actions.action: Engage at-risk North-West accounts with SLA guarantees now
actions.monitoring: Track North-West SLA % and account status weekly

what_could_change: Confirmation that WH-07 throughput has fully recovered would strengthen this conclusion.
caveats: Based on a small number of accounts, so each customer's decision carries outsized weight.
